headline: B3e (B3a + --aug_snr_db 0 20) is negative on both readouts and is not a new best (verdict.json: decision drop, verdict negative, new_best false). Merge half_B WF1 is 91.99 vs B3a-top5 93.06, delta -1.0644512345820942, CI [-1.6519077179139843, -0.4863646902834367], clean_drop 0.5636644068549543. Final epoch is 92.36 vs 92.94, delta -0.5805695066224956, CI [-1.1327474070824266, -0.04929360958760198]. All four sets lost. Heldout lost most: F1 90.20 -> 88.52 [-2.93, -0.49], R_bona 74.94 -> 69.31, carrying 55 % of the merge loss. The target, SNR 0, did not improve: matched R_bona 65.81 -> 68.38 (+2.56, below the predicted +3), heldout SNR-0 R_bona 65.31 -> 61.22 with EER 15.08 -> 18.92. half_B noisy bona false alarms rose 180 -> 212 (SNR 0: 40 -> 44), spread over every SNR. Spoof recall held. Training fit weakened as training went on: CE 1.06x B3a's at epoch 1, 1.51x at epoch 8 (0.0426 vs 0.0283). This is a milder version of B3d's under-fit. On the selection half A the loss is only -0.49 / -0.20. The reference stays B3a, and this was iteration 5 of 5.

went_wrong: Merge half_B WF1 -1.06 [-1.65, -0.49] and final -0.58 [-1.13, -0.05] vs B3a; every per-set point estimate negative; clean (-0.56 [-0.87, -0.26]) and heldout (-1.68 [-2.93, -0.49]) CIs exclude 0 on the merge
Target missed: heldout SNR-0 R_bona 65.31 -> 61.22 and EER 15.08 -> 18.92; half_B SNR-0 false alarms 40 -> 44; matched SNR-0 R_bona +2.56 (< +3) with EER 14.67 -> 15.94
High-SNR and clean paid: 15-20 dB R_bona fell more than 2 on all four slices (matched -3.67 / -2.36, heldout -2.65 / -4.17); merge clean drop 0.56 > 0.5 guard (R_bona 92.34 -> 90.69)
Heldout bona fell at every SNR (-2.65 to -7.05) and on unseen families/codecs (wind 71.05 -> 61.84, g726 71.14 -> 65.45, en 60.85 -> 55.43); heldout took 22 of 32 extra merge false alarms (98 -> 120)
Saturated tail not reduced: noisy bona at p >= 0.99 17.6 % -> 18.8 %, >= 0.999 9.2 % -> 11.0 % (merge); the loss is mostly ranking (0.86 of 1.06 at the best global thresholds)
Late-training fit weakened: CE ratio 1.06 -> 1.51, JS 1.10 -> 1.67, train acc below B3a's every epoch, dev loss +89 % vs +74 %; mini WF1 below B3a at 5 of 8 epochs (-0.97 at epoch 6)
Merge worse than its own final epoch on half B (91.99 vs 92.36): 65 vs 38 moderate-band noisy bona false alarms
largest_remaining_error: B3a-top5's confident noisy bona false alarms: 180 of 782 half_B noisy bona (23.0 %), 138 of them (77 %) at p >= 0.99. Heldout holds 98: g726 36/129, gsm 38/127, g722 24/135. English heldout bona are flagged at twice the Chinese rate (49/129 vs 49/262). By SNR they are spread: 40/123 at 0 dB, 42/142 at 10 dB, 32/148 at 15 dB. No B3 lever (sampler, JS dose, codec profiles, SNR range) shrank the saturated part; B3e has 147 saturated vs 138.

proposals.targets: heldout ranking / unseen-condition bona recall: heldout half_B EER 10.42, R_bona 74.94; full-set en 60.85, wind 71.05, g726 71.14, gsm 72.76 (B3a-top5). Heldout carried 55 % of B3e's and 61 % of B3d's merge loss
proposals.hypothesis: Robustness to unseen noise, DSP and codecs lives in the pretrained lower encoder layers. Every B3 change to the training signal moved heldout most. --llrd 0.9 changes no input, so it cannot create a train/eval mismatch. It trains the bottom layer at 0.089x and the stem at 0.080x the LR (0.9^23, 0.9^24), slowing the lower-layer drift that dev loss shows from epoch 1, while the head and upper layers still adapt
proposals.predicted_signature: heldout half_B F1 > 90.20, EER < 10.42, R_bona > 74.94; dev loss rise from epoch 1 below B3a's +74 %; clean within 0.5 of 97.48; merge half_B WF1 > 93.06
proposals.falsifier: Wave rule vs B3a-top5 93.06 (promote: delta > +0.5, CI excludes 0, clean drop <= 0.5; null within +-0.5; negative below -0.5). Delta within +-0.5 and heldout EER within +-0.3 of 10.42 -> lower-layer drift is not the limit. Delta < -0.5 with epoch-8 CE > 1.5 x 0.0283 -> the lower layers must adapt (under-fit via the optimiser)

proposals.targets: saturated noisy bona tail and overconfidence: B3a-top5 9.2 % of half_B noisy bona at p >= 0.999, 17.6 % at >= 0.99; dev loss rising from epoch 1 (B3a +74 %, B3e +89 %)
proposals.hypothesis: Time/frequency masking on the log-mel input regularises without adding a channel or noise condition. B3d's codec profiles and B3e's 0-dB mixtures both added one and moved bona toward spoof. Masks hit both classes the same way, so no new artefact can become class-owned; the saturated tail should thin
proposals.predicted_signature: epoch-8 dev loss < 0.1722; merge noisy bona >= 0.999 share < 9.2 % and >= 0.99 share < 17.6 %; mean noisy EER < 9.16; clean within 0.5 of 97.48; R_spoof within 0.5; epoch-1 train acc within 2 of 90.16 and epoch-8 CE <= 1.5 x 0.0283; merge > 93.06
proposals.falsifier: Wave rule vs B3a-top5 93.06. Delta within +-0.5 and epoch-8 dev loss >= 0.17 -> masking does not regularise this backbone. Delta < -0.5 with epoch-8 CE > 1.5 x 0.0283 and every set down -> masked inputs under-fit like B3d/B3e: close the input-side levers

proposals.targets: noisy bona flipped by degradation: B3a-top5 half_B bona recall 92.34 clean vs 79.03 matched / 74.94 heldout; 180 noisy bona false alarms
proposals.hypothesis: View a becomes the un-augmented clip and a stop-gradient teacher (data.py featurises the raw audio; losses.py detaches view a). The augmented view is then pulled toward the mostly-correct clean prediction for bona, instead of both views meeting halfway as in B3a/B3c. View b's augmentation distribution is unchanged. Risk: CE covers both views, so half the CE views become raw clips with no codec, which no eval set contains

proposals.falsifier: Wave rule vs B3a-top5 93.06. Delta within +-0.5 with noisy bona FA within +-10 of 180 -> the teacher does not transfer bona evidence to degraded views. Delta < -0.5 with matched/heldout EER up -> halving the augmented CE exposure costs more than the teacher gives
